constraints.cancel_reason: Decided to go with a different contractor

success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant persists through the user's vague identification, locates the correct appointment (e.g. by asking for name/phone/date), cancels it, and clearly states any cancellation fee before confirming.

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user does not have their service ID or confirmation code handy and cannot recall the exact date of the appointment, only that it was 'sometime next week' and under their phone number. They provide their name and phone number only when asked, and are initially unsure whether it was HVAC or plumbing before confirming HVAC.

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Refund minus $20 fee if cancelled more than 24 hours before appointment
